svg.title: Illustration of the rig: a Freightliner Cascadia tractor and 53-foot refrigerated trailer
svg.desc: Side view. The tractor frame runs behind the sleeper cab to the fifth wheel. Fairings come off the back of the cab, and a gap of about five feet in all separates the back of the cab from the trailer, and the refrigeration unit is mounted on the outside of the trailer front wall inside that gap. Steer axle, two drive axles and two trailer axles are marked.
svg.text: bolted to the outside of the trailer's front wall
